sources.title: Hyper-SD: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Hyper-SD is a state-of-the-art diffusion model acceleration technique developed by ByteDance that enables fast image generation through trajectory segmented consistency distillation. The model works as LoRA weights that attach to existing base models including FLUX.1-dev, SD3-Medium, SDXL Base 1.0, and Stable Diffusion v1.5, allowing image generation in 1 to 16 steps depending on the ...
